ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent investigation into Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, and follow the money to uncover the extent of the fraud.
questions: How much money has been lost to Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and corruption in the Medicaid system, and could lead to significant reforms.

ideas.title: The Welfare Fraud Epidemic: A Look at the Recent Investigation in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent investigation into welfare fraud in Minnesota, and examine the extent of the problem.
questions: How much money has been lost to welfare fraud in Minnesota?
What are the root causes of the problem?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to shed light on a significant problem in the welfare system, and could lead to reforms to prevent future fraud.
